recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It finishes the Applied FHIR-49941 edits in active MeasureReport build inputs without changing unrelated MeasureReport semantics. Treat the related issue keys as separate reconciliation decisions rather than as resolved by this commit.
issue_request: FHIR-49941 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core CQI change request for R6. It asked for MeasureReport editorial and example updates from the May 2025 ballot review, including grammar and concision fixes, removal of community-feedback wording, updated examples and DEQM example guidance, consistent e.g./i.e. wording, an updated category short display, and a corrected subjectReport comment.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3423 merged the initial application on 2025-03-19. Direct FHIR-49941 commits f91064f48df14694e23ee125f232262491430154 and f0bc09334ce76f13489db125d782fca9ee84409c updated most MeasureReport introduction, notes, examples-header, and StructureDefinition text, while neighboring PR commits updated MeasureReport examples for related CQI issues. The current source still retained stale 2014/2018 MeasureReport example periods, a singular DEQM guide label with a generic link, a MeasureReport.inputParameters comment that named only the deprecated $evaluate-measure operation, an uppercase I.e. in improvementNotation, and the same subjectReport run-on wording on the stratum population parallel element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MeasureReport as an active resource, and source/measurereport/list-MeasureReport-examples.xml registers the edited MeasureReport examples, so the edited XML files are current build inputs. FHIR-37571 is Applied and established $evaluate as the current Measure operation name while deprecating $evaluate-measure, supporting the MeasureReport.inputParameters wording update. No Zulip or Confluence search found a community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated the registered MeasureReport example periods and report dates to 2025, pointed the examples header directly at the DEQM examples section with the correct Data Exchange for Quality Measures title, changed the MeasureReport.inputParameters operation example to $evaluate, normalized I.e. to i.e., and applied the accepted subjectReport comment wording to the stratum population subjectReport element that retained the same stale sentence.
source_changes: source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: changed the inputParameters example operation from $evaluate-measure to $evaluate, normalized improvementNotation i.e. casing, and corrected the stratum population subjectReport comment to match the accepted subjectResults wording.
source/measurereport/measurereport-examples-header.xml: corrected the Data Exchange for Quality Measures title and linked directly to the DEQM examples section.
source/measurereport/measurereport-cms146-cat1-example.xml: updated narrative and structured report date/period values from 2014 to 2025.
